summary: Unconditional texture-object constructor: runs a DirectX texture/mipmap-chain base init on this with size 8 and count 1, then overwrites the vtable pointer at this[0] with off_5ADC6C and returns this. Called by the DirectX texture surface factory.

operations.description: Call DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain(this, a2, 8u, 1) to perform base initialization with an 8-byte unit size and a chain count of 1.

unresolved: Meaning of a2 (second texture-creation argument) is caller-supplied and unknown here.
Object class implied by vtable off_5ADC6C is not named in the packet.
Relationship to sibling constructors (same helper, different size and vtable) is not evidenced.
